title: feat(nm2simt2z): simultaneous M and O freeze t+1 vs t+2 on two-axis opposite z-probes: reverse HOLD, face HOLD, composition HOLD
science: Simultaneous freeze t+1 vs t+2 on opposite z-probes. Its own steelman raises 'because unsigned axis-cover also HOLDs at each z-probe, simultaneous is axis-cover' - on this cell the two predicates are indeed extensionally identical and the rebuttal is only a definitional restatement.
